start_angle.description: Where the arc starts, radians from +X, counter-clockwise.

sweep.description: How far it turns, radians: positive counter-clockwise.

BackOf.description: Which setup a back setup turns over, and how (docs/specs/two-sided.md §3).

register.description: How the turned board is put back in place.

setup.description: The id of the front setup: the board as it lies first.

turn.description: How the board is turned over.

ClearingPass.description:
A clearing pass with its own end mill, inside an operation's shapes and depths: a
pocket's rest pass (docs/specs/rest-passes.md §2: an endmill smaller than the tool before
it, clearing only what that tool leaves) or a V-carve's floor pass
(docs/specs/vcarve-wide-strokes.md §4: an end mill clearing the floor between the walls,
before the V-carve).

enabled.description: False: kept, but not cut. Missing: true.

entry.description: How the tool goes down: `plunge`, `ramp` or `helix`.

plunge_feed.description: The feed going down into the material, mm/min.

step_down.description: The deepest each pass goes, mm.

stepover.description: The distance between the clearing rings, as a fraction of the tool diameter.

tool.description: The id of the project tool it cuts with (`tools`): an end mill.

CornerChoice.description: A corner with its own bone, chosen by the user.

along.description:
The wall a T-bone runs along, `longer` or `shorter`: the notch is in the other.
Required with a T-bone; null otherwise.

Corners.description:
How the tool reaches into the inside corners it would leave round, so a square part
fits: every corner on the tool's side up to `max_angle`.

oneOf.description: In along the corner's bisector.

max_angle.description: Only corners this sharp or sharper, radians (1.745 = 100°).

oneOf.description: In along the longer wall: the notch is in the shorter one.

max_angle.description: Only corners this sharp or sharper, radians (1.745 = 100°).

CustomPost.description: A user post-processor's config and template, exactly as read from the posts folder.

config.description: The post's settings file (TOML), as copied.

Drawing.description:
The project's drawing: shapes in millimetres, or (only for jobs from before v4) a
reference to a DXF that still has to be embedded.

dxfs.description:
The DXFs the imported shapes came from, each as at its last import or update, with
its own placement.

frames.description:
Frames for signs that are drawn again round what they go round when it changes.
Left out of the file when there are none, so projects without them open in older
versions.

groups.description:
Groups of drawn shapes and texts, selected, moved and cut as one. Left out of the
file when there are none, so projects without groups open in older versions.

hidden.description:
Groups and layers not drawn on the canvas (they are still cut): `dxf:1`,
`dxf:1/layer:Cut`, `image:1`, `text:1`, `drawn:circle`, `drawn:rectangle`,
`drawn:polyline`.

images.description: Pictures traced into shapes, for V-carving.

models.description:
3D models carved as reliefs from the top. Left out of the file when there are none,
so projects without them open in older versions, which refuse one with them.

next_shape_id.description: The id the next new shape gets. Ids are never reused.

texts.description:
Texts written into shapes, for V-carving, pocketing or profiling. Left out of the
file when there are none, so projects without text open in older versions.

flattened.description: How many curves of each type (splines, ellipses) were turned into arcs.

format.description: What kind of file it is: a DXF or an SVG.

id.description: The DXF's id, which its shapes and selectors name.

ignored.description: How many entities of each type were left out (text, dimensions, …).

imported.description: How many entities of each type were imported.

issues.description: What the import found: the import report.

name.description:
Its name in the Browser and messages; the file's name without its extension
at first.

placement.description: How the imported drawing was moved, turned and scaled on the stock.

px_per_inch.description:
An SVG without a real size: the pixels per inch chosen for it, used again on update.
None for a DXF and an SVG with real units.

sha256.description: The DXF's SHA-256, to tell whether it changed.

units.description: The DXF's units: `mm` or `inch`. Inch drawings are converted to mm on import.

units_from.description: Where the units came from: the DXF itself, or the user's choice.

EdgeSide.description:
Where a chamfer's waste is: around the shape (a part's outline) or within it (a hole's or
a pocket's rim).

Entry.description:
How the tool goes down into the material at the start of each pass, for pockets and
follow paths (a profile always spirals: its `ramp_angle`).

oneOf.description: Straight down: needs a centre-cutting tool. An empty struct variant, as `Rings`.

Down along the path and back, never steeper than `ramp_angle` (radians,
0 < angle <= 30°).

ramp_angle.description: The steepest the ramp goes, radians: more than 0, at most 30° (0.5236).

oneOf.description:
Pockets only: down round a circle of `radius` (the tool centre's), never steeper
than `ramp_angle`.

radius.description: The helix's radius, mm: less than the tool radius.

ramp_angle.description: The steepest the helix goes, radians: more than 0, at most 30° (0.5236).

FillPattern.description:
The pattern a `PatternOp` engraves (docs/specs/fill-pattern.md §3). Angles in radians from
the X axis, counter-clockwise; lengths in mm.

oneOf.description: Parallel straight lines, `spacing` apart (centre to centre), at `angle`.
Two sets of lines: at `angle`, and at `angle` + `between` (more than 0, at most 90°).
The shape's outline repeated inwards, `spacing` apart, as closed rings.

Parallel sine waves at `angle`, `spacing` apart: `wavelength` long, `height` from top
to bottom.

Rows `spacing` apart of strokes `length` long with `gap` between, every other row
shifted half a stroke and gap (docs/specs/fill-pattern.md §14).

whole.description: Only strokes the shape doesn't cut.

oneOf.description:
Columns of strokes `length` long at 45° to `angle`, `spacing` apart along the column,
every other column mirrored, meeting in chevrons.

Rows `spacing` apart of half circles of `radius` side by side, every other row
shifted by a radius.

Round the middle of each shape: rings `spacing` apart of strokes `length` long
pointing outwards, `pitch` apart round the ring, every other ring turned half a pitch.

Finish.description: A finishing pass on a profile.

stock.description: Left on the wall by the roughing passes, mm: more than 0, less than the tool radius.

Frame.description:
A frame for a sign that follows what it goes round (docs/specs/sign-maker.md §4): its
outline and border lines are ordinary drawn shapes, drawn again from these values when
the texts or shapes it goes round change. Editing its shapes by hand ends that: the
record goes and they stay as they are.

around.description: What it goes round. None: drawn to a size, following nothing.

border_corners.description:
The borders' own corner style, for a rectangular frame; None: they follow the
outline's shape, each `gap` further in (docs/specs/sign-maker.md §5).

border_width.description:
The width of a border's groove at the surface, mm: the margin is measured to its
inner edge, and a double border's lines are twice it apart. 0: lines as drawn.

borders.description: Its border lines inside the outline, outside in, by shape id.

center.description: Where it was last drawn: the outline's centre, mm.

corner.description: The corner size, mm: what it is depends on the kind (`chipload frame kinds`).

double.description:
Each border two lines, twice `border_width` apart, which leaves a ridge as wide as
a groove between them.

gap.description:
From the outline to the first border, and from one border to the next (from its
inner line, for double borders), mm.

height.description: The outline's height as last drawn, mm.

margin.description: From the box of what it goes round to its innermost line, mm.

outline.description: Its outline, by shape id; the frame is named by it.

width.description: The outline's width as last drawn, mm.

FrameAround.description:
What a frame goes round: texts with all their letters, pictures with all their traced
shapes, and other shapes, by id.

FrameCorners.description: The corner style of a rectangular frame's borders (docs/specs/sign-maker.md §5).

oneOf.description: Straight down at the hole's centre, `peck` mm at a time.

peck.description:
Drill this many mm at a time, lifting out between pecks to clear chips. Null: in
one go.

oneOf.description:
A helix at the wall, at most `step_down` mm per turn and never steeper than
`ramp_angle` (radians, 0 < angle <= 30°), then one level circle.

direction.description: `climb` or `conventional`, as for a profile inside the hole.

ramp_angle.description: The steepest the helix goes, radians: more than 0, at most 30° (0.5236).

step_down.description: The most the helix goes down per turn, mm.

Image.description:
A picture traced into shapes: the picture itself, where it goes, and how it becomes black
and white. Its traced shapes are `path` shapes on its layer that name it in `image`.

arcs.description: Traced edges are fitted with arcs as well as lines.

blur.description: Blur before the threshold, in pixels, 0 to 10; 0: none.

data.description: The picture file itself (PNG, JPEG or BMP), base64-encoded.

id.description: The image's id, which its traced shapes name.

invert.description: Carve the light parts instead of the dark ones.

layer.description: The layer its traced shapes go on.

min_area.description: Black or white specks smaller than this are dropped, mm², 0 to 100.

rotation.description:
Turned counter-clockwise about the picture's centre, degrees, at least 0 and less
than 360. `x`, `y` and `width` are before the turn; the traced shapes are turned
after the trace.

smoothing.description: How far a traced edge may be simplified away from the picture's edge, mm, 0.01 to 1.

threshold.description:
Grey values below this (0–255) are black: 1 to 254, or "auto" to pick it from the
picture (Otsu's method).

trace.description:
What it is traced into: the black parts' outlines (for a V-carve) or their centre
lines (for a follow path).

width.description: The picture's width on the stock, mm; its height follows from the picture.

x.description: X of the picture's lower-left corner on the stock, mm.

y.description: Y of the picture's lower-left corner on the stock, mm.

anyOf.description: Grey values below this are black, 1 to 254.

ImageThreshold.description: Where grey turns black: "auto" or a grey value.

ImageTrace.description: What a picture is traced into.

oneOf.description: Closed outlines round the black parts, black inside.
Open (or closed) paths along the black strokes' middles.

InflateProfile.description: How an inflated shape rises from its edge.

oneOf.description: A quarter circle: steep at the edge, flat on top.
A straight rise: a ridge along narrow strokes.

Instance.description:
The part placed again (docs/specs/instances.md §2): mirrored, then turned, about the
part's centre, then moved.

angle.description: Then turned about the part's centre, radians, counter-clockwise.

id.description: Its number in the part, from 2 (1 is the part as drawn).

mirror.description: Mirrored about the part's centre line first. Null: as drawn.

InstanceOrder.description: In which order a part and its instances are cut.

oneOf.description: Each operation on every instance, then the next operation.

Every operation on one instance, then the next instance. Called `by_copy` before
schema 38, and `by_part` before parts came (schema 22).

Joint.description: The joint along a seam between two pieces (docs/specs/pieces.md §4).

oneOf.description: Round heads on narrower necks, alternating in and out, as on a jigsaw puzzle.
Square teeth with rounded corners.

radius.description:
Radius of the lead arcs, mm: more than 0, at most 10 tool diameters. Smaller where
there's no room.

custom_post.description:
Your own post-processor, copied into the project when chosen, so it gives the same
G-code anywhere. Null: `post` is a built-in one.

gcode_units.description:
The units the G-code is written in: `mm` (G21) or `inch` (G20). Everything else in
the project stays in mm. Since schema 28.

library_uid.description:
The `uid` of the machine profile these values came from, for reference; nothing
that cuts reads it. Null: not from a profile.

max_feed.description:
The machine's fastest feed, mm/min: higher feeds are refused, and the cycle time
uses it for rapids. Null: unknown.

name.description: The machine profile these values came from, for reference; nothing reads it.

post.description: The post-processor: `grbl`, `linuxcnc`, `mach3`, or the name of your own.

safe_z.description: The height for rapid moves sideways, mm above Z0. Above the stock top.

tool_change.description:
With several tools: `files` (one file per tool) or `program` (one file with tool
changes).

travel.description:
The machine's travel, mm. When set, a program that moves farther is refused. Null:
not checked.

MaterialRef.description: A library material, as a project names it.

name.description: Its name when chosen, shown when the library no longer has it.

Mirror.description: How a part is cut mirrored: about the vertical or the horizontal centre line of its box.

oneOf.description: About the vertical centre line: left and right change places, X is mirrored.
About the horizontal centre line: top and bottom change places, Y is mirrored.

Model.description:
A 3D model (an STL file) carved as a relief from the top: the file itself, which way is
up, and where it lies on the board. Its footprint outline is a `path` shape on its layer
that names it in `model`.

depth.description: How deep the relief goes, from the model's top to its lowest point, mm.

id.description: The model's id, which its outline and reliefs name.

keep.description:
The share of the turned model's height kept, from its top, more than 0 and at most
1: what lies below is cut away, its back (docs/specs/relief-wizard.md §5). Width,
depth and the outline are the kept part's. 1 (the whole model) when missing.

layer.description: The layer its footprint outline goes on.

name.description:
Its name in the Browser and messages: the file's name without its extension at
first.

picture.description:
Missing: the model is an STL file. Present: `data` is a picture (PNG, JPEG or BMP)
read as a depth map with these settings; `up` is `z` and `proportional` false.

proportional.description:
The depth follows the width, in the model's own proportion: made again whenever the
model changes (decision 4).

rotation.description:
Turned counter-clockwise about the footprint's centre, degrees, at least 0 and less
than 360.

units.description:
The unit the file was read in, for its size on import only: the model is placed by
`width` (decision 2).

up.description: Which of the model's axes points up on the board.

width.description: The footprint's width on the board, mm: it scales X and Y alike.

x.description: X of the footprint's lower-left corner on the board, mm, before the turn.

y.description: Y of the footprint's lower-left corner on the board, mm, before the turn.

ModelUp.description: Which of a model's axes points up on the board.

MouldEnds.description: How a moulding ends on an open path (docs/specs/moulding.md §4).

oneOf.description: The full profile right to the path's end.
The profile turned a quarter round the path's end point.
The section's depth fading to the surface over `length` mm at each end.

MouldProfile.description:
A moulding's cross-section (docs/specs/moulding.md §3): a built-in shape by its size, or
a drawn open shape read as the section.

oneOf.description: A concave quarter circle: `radius` deep at the path, at the surface `radius` in.
A convex quarter circle: the edge rounded, `radius` down at the path.
An S, `width` wide and `depth` deep: a cove into a round-over, half the width each.
A raised half round `2 × radius` wide, its top at the surface.
A half-round groove `2 × radius` wide and `radius` deep.

A drawn open shape, by id: across to the right, up the page; its leftmost point at
the path, its highest point the surface.

MouldSide.description: Which side of the path a moulding's profile lies on (docs/specs/moulding.md §4).

oneOf.description: Left of an open path as drawn.
Right of an open path as drawn.
Inside a closed path.
Outside a closed path.

gap.description: The least distance between what two instances cut, mm.

margin.description: The least distance from what an instance cuts to the board's edge, mm.

clearance.description:
How far the cut moves into the material that is kept, mm: positive removes more (a
larger pocket, a smaller part), negative leaves material. Less than the tool radius.

corner_choices.description:
Corners with their own bone, whatever `corners` says. Missing or empty: none. Left
out when empty.

corners.description:
Dogbones or T-bones in the inside corners, so square parts fit. Null: the corners
stay round.

enabled.description: False: the operation stays in the project but isn't cut. Missing: true.

end_depth.description:
Where the cut ends, mm down from the stock top. More than the start depth; below the
stock bottom only within `stock.max_overcut`.

finish.description:
A finishing pass: the roughing passes leave `stock` mm on the wall, and one last lap
at full depth takes it off. Null: none.

material.description: The library material its feeds come from. Null: its own values.

name.description: A name for the operation, shown in the list and on the setup sheet. Empty: none.

part.description: The id of the part it belongs to (`parts`).

plunge_feed.description: The feed going down into the material, mm/min.

ramp_angle.description:
The steepest the spiral ramp goes down along the contour, radians: more than 0, at
most 30° (0.5236). A profile always spirals down (docs/specs/profile-always-spiral.md).

select.description: What the operation cuts: the shapes on a layer, or shapes by id.

side.description:
Which side of the line the tool cuts: `outside` (cutting a part out), `inside` (a
hole) or `on` the line.

skin.description:
An onion skin: the passes stop `thickness` mm above the end depth, and one last lap
cuts through it. Null: none.

start_depth.description:
Where the cut starts, mm down from the stock top: 0 for the top, more when an
earlier operation already cut down to there.

starts.description:
Where the cut starts, as points in drawing coordinates (mm): each moves the start of
the ring (contour) nearest to it. Empty: chosen by Chipload.

step_down.description:
The deepest each pass goes, mm. The passes are equal, and the last one ends exactly
at the end depth.

tabs.description:
Holding tabs left at the bottom of the cut, so a part cut out doesn't come loose.
Null: none.

through.description:
Cut through the stock: how far below the stock bottom it ends, mm. The end depth is
then the stock thickness plus this, and follows the thickness. Null: the end depth as
set.

tool.description: The id of the project tool it cuts with (`tools`).

clearance.description:
How far the cut moves into the material that is kept, mm: positive removes more (a
larger pocket, a smaller part), negative leaves material. Less than the tool radius.

corner_choices.description:
Corners with their own bone, whatever `corners` says. Missing or empty: none. Left
out when empty.

corners.description:
Dogbones or T-bones in the inside corners, so square parts fit. Null: the corners
stay round.

enabled.description: False: the operation stays in the project but isn't cut. Missing: true.

end_depth.description:
Where the cut ends, mm down from the stock top. More than the start depth; below the
stock bottom only within `stock.max_overcut`.

entry.description:
How the tool goes down at the start of each pass: `plunge` (straight down; needs a
centre-cutting tool) or `ramp` along the path; pockets also `helix`. Missing:
plunge.

finish.description:
A finishing pass: the roughing leaves `wall` mm on the walls and `floor` mm on the
floor, then one level pass takes the floor and one lap each wall. Null: none. Left out
when none.

lead.description:
A quarter-circle lead-in and lead-out from the cleared side onto the wall. Null:
none.

material.description: The library material its feeds come from. Null: its own values.

name.description: A name for the operation, shown in the list and on the setup sheet. Empty: none.

part.description: The id of the part it belongs to (`parts`).

plunge_feed.description: The feed going down into the material, mm/min.

rest.description:
Rest machining: clear only what a larger tool leaves in these shapes. Null: the
whole pocket.

rest_passes.description:
Rest passes: smaller endmills that clear what this pocket's tool (or the pass before)
leaves, in its shapes and depths. Missing or empty: none. Left out when empty.

select.description: What the operation cuts: the shapes on a layer, or shapes by id.

slot_feed.description:
The feed of the rings that cut full width (those with no ring inside them), mm/min.
Null: `feed`.

slot_step_down.description:
The deepest each step of a full-width ring goes, mm: it goes down in such steps to
each depth pass, before the other rings cut the pass at once. Null: `step_down`.

start_depth.description:
Where the cut starts, mm down from the stock top: 0 for the top, more when an
earlier operation already cut down to there.

starts.description:
Where each wall ring starts, as points in drawing coordinates (mm): each moves the
start of the wall ring nearest to it. Empty: chosen by Chipload.

step_down.description:
The deepest each pass goes, mm. The passes are equal, and the last one ends exactly
at the end depth.

stepover.description:
The distance between the clearing rings, as a fraction of the tool diameter: more
than 0, at most 1.

through.description:
Cut through the stock: how far below the stock bottom it ends, mm. The end depth is
then the stock thickness plus this, and follows the thickness. Null: the end depth as
set.

tool.description: The id of the project tool it cuts with (`tools`).

oneOf.description:
V-carve: a V-bit follows the centre line of closed shapes, as deep as makes the cut
exactly as wide as the shape.

enabled.description: False: the operation stays in the project but isn't cut. Missing: true.

end_depth.description:
The deepest the V-bit's tip may go, mm down from the stock top. Strokes that need
more are carved to it, narrower than drawn, with a warning.

feed.description: The feed, mm/min, for moves no steeper than 45°.

floor.description:
A floor pass: an end mill that clears the floor between the walls of strokes too
wide to carve from their centre line. Missing: none. Left out when missing.

ignore_kinks_deg.description:
Corners where the outline turns by less than this, degrees (0 to 90), get no branch
of the centre line: the bit doesn't rise into every kink. Missing: 0, every corner
carved, as before the setting existed.

material.description: The library material its feeds come from. Null: its own values.

name.description: A name for the operation, shown in the list and on the setup sheet. Empty: none.

part.description: The id of the part it belongs to (`parts`).

passes.description:
How many depth passes, 1 to [`MAX_VCARVE_PASSES`]: each removes the same
cross-section, the last at the end depth (docs/specs/v-carve.md decision 12).

plug.description:
The plug of a V-carve inlay: the rest of the board is carved, its outline taken
`plug.start_depth` below the surface, so the shapes stand as a tapered plug that fits
the pocket a V-carve of the same shapes cuts. Missing: an ordinary V-carve. Left out
when missing.

plunge_feed.description: The feed for moves steeper than 45°, mm/min.

select.description: What the operation cuts: the shapes on a layer, or shapes by id.

start_depth.description:
The surface carved, mm down from the stock top: 0 for the top, more to carve on a
floor an earlier pocket cut.

step_down.description:
An ordinary step down instead, mm: equal passes, none deeper than it, the last at
the end depth, as in a pocket. Missing: passes of equal load (`passes`), which is
kept meanwhile. Left out when missing.

tool.description: The id of the project tool it cuts with (`tools`).

oneOf.description: Follow path: the tool centre on the selected shapes, open or closed.

enabled.description: False: the operation stays in the project but isn't cut. Missing: true.

end_depth.description:
Where the cut ends, mm down from the stock top. More than the start depth; below the
stock bottom only within `stock.max_overcut`.

entry.description: How the tool goes down at the start of each pass: `plunge` or `ramp` along the path.

material.description: The library material its feeds come from. Null: its own values.

name.description: A name for the operation, shown in the list and on the setup sheet. Empty: none.

part.description: The id of the part it belongs to (`parts`).

plunge_feed.description: The feed going down into the material, mm/min.

select.description: What the operation cuts: the shapes on a layer, or shapes by id.

start_depth.description:
Where the cut starts, mm down from the stock top: 0 for the top, more when an
earlier operation already cut down to there.

step_down.description:
The deepest each pass goes, mm. The passes are equal, and the last one ends exactly
at the end depth.

through.description:
Cut through the stock: how far below the stock bottom it ends, mm. The end depth is
then the stock thickness plus this, and follows the thickness. Null: the end depth as
set.

tool.description: The id of the project tool it cuts with (`tools`).

oneOf.description: Chamfer: a V-bit's flank on the line of closed shapes, breaking their top edge.

enabled.description: False: the operation stays in the project but isn't cut. Missing: true.

entry.description: How the tool goes down at the start of each pass: `plunge` or `ramp` along the path.

material.description: The library material its feeds come from. Null: its own values.

name.description: A name for the operation, shown in the list and on the setup sheet. Empty: none.

part.description: The id of the part it belongs to (`parts`).

plunge_feed.description: The feed going down into the material, mm/min.

select.description:
What the operation cuts: the shapes on a layer, or shapes by id. Closed shapes only;
open ones are skipped with a note.

side.description:
Where the waste is: `outside` the shape (a part's outline) or `inside` it (a hole's
or a pocket's rim).

start_depth.description:
Where the edge is, mm down from the stock top: 0 for the top, more for the edge of a
step an earlier operation cut.

step_down.description: The deepest each pass goes, mm, in equal passes. Null: one pass.

tool.description: The id of the project tool it cuts with (`tools`): a V-bit with its angle.

width.description:
The chamfer's width at the surface, mm, measured from the line into the part. More
than 0, at most half the bit's cone (its diameter less its tip, halved).

oneOf.description: Flute: a groove on the line of open shapes that ramps in and out at their ends.

enabled.description: False: the operation stays in the project but isn't cut. Missing: true.

end_depth.description: The flute's depth through its middle, mm down from the stock top.

feed.description: The cutting feed, mm/min, ramps included.

material.description: The library material its feeds come from. Null: its own values.

name.description: A name for the operation, shown in the list and on the setup sheet. Empty: none.

part.description: The id of the part it belongs to (`parts`).

plunge_feed.description: The feed going straight down, mm/min.

ramp_end.description:
How far along the shape before its last end the flute starts to rise, mm. 0: a
square end.

ramp_start.description:
How far along the shape from its first end the flute reaches its depth, mm. 0: a
square end.

select.description:
What the operation cuts: the shapes on a layer, or shapes by id. Open shapes only;
closed ones are skipped with a note.

start_depth.description: Where the flute starts at its ends, mm down from the stock top: 0 for the top.

step_down.description: The deepest each pass goes, mm, in equal passes. Null: one pass.

tool.description:
The id of the project tool it cuts with (`tools`): a ball nose, a V-bit or an
endmill.

oneOf.description: Pattern: grooves of lines, cross-hatch, rings or waves engraved inside closed shapes.

enabled.description: False: the operation stays in the project but isn't cut. Missing: true.

end_depth.description: How deep the grooves go, mm down from the stock top.

inside.description:
True: the grooves stay inside the shape's line and out of its holes, clipped half a
groove's width in. False: they run up to the line, centred on it.

material.description: The library material its feeds come from. Null: its own values.

name.description: A name for the operation, shown in the list and on the setup sheet. Empty: none.

part.description: The id of the part it belongs to (`parts`).

plunge_feed.description: The feed going straight down, mm/min.

ramp.description: How long each groove ramps in and out at its ends, mm, as a flute. 0: square ends.

select.description: What the operation fills: closed shapes, the selected shapes inside them as holes.

start_depth.description: Where the grooves start, mm down from the stock top: 0 for the top.

step_down.description: The deepest each pass goes, mm, in equal passes. Null: one pass.

tool.description: The id of the project tool it cuts with (`tools`): a V-bit, a ball nose or an endmill.

oneOf.description: Prism: closed shapes left standing as roofs, a sharp ridge along their centre line.

enabled.description: False: the operation stays in the project but isn't cut. Missing: true.

material.description: The library material its feeds come from. Null: its own values.

max_depth.description:
The deepest an edge goes below the start depth, mm, for bevelled shapes with a flat
top. Null: as deep as the shapes and the bit's cone need.

name.description: A name for the operation, shown in the list and on the setup sheet. Empty: none.

part.description: The id of the part it belongs to (`parts`).

plunge_feed.description: The feed going straight down, mm/min.

select.description: What the operation carves: closed shapes, the selected shapes inside them as holes.

start_depth.description: Where the surface is, mm down from the stock top: 0 for the top.

step_down.description: The deepest each pass goes, mm, in equal passes. Null: one pass.

tool.description: The id of the project tool it cuts with (`tools`): a V-bit with its angle.

oneOf.description: Moulding: a profile swept along a path, in passes along it.

enabled.description: False: the operation stays in the project but isn't cut. Missing: true.

ends.description: How it ends on open paths.

material.description: The library material its feeds come from. Null: its own values.

name.description: A name for the operation, shown in the list and on the setup sheet. Empty: none.

part.description: The id of the part it belongs to (`parts`).

plunge_feed.description: The feed going straight down, mm/min.

select.description: The paths the moulding runs along: open or closed shapes.

side.description: The side of the path the profile lies on.

start_depth.description: Where the surface is, mm down from the stock top: 0 for the top.

step_down.description: The deepest each level goes, mm, in equal levels. Null: one level.

stepover.description: The distance between passes across the profile, mm.

tool.description: The id of the project tool it cuts with (`tools`): a ball nose or an endmill.

oneOf.description: Holes: drilled with a drill, bored with a helix with an endmill.

dowels.description:
Dowel holes for turning the board over (docs/specs/two-sided.md §6): drawn circles
on the turn axis, cut through the board and `through` mm into the spoilboard for the
pins, deeper than the stock's max overcut allows any other cut. Missing: false.

enabled.description: False: the operation stays in the project but isn't cut. Missing: true.

end_depth.description:
Where the hole ends, mm down from the stock top. For a drill, the depth of its
point.

feed.description: A bore's feed round its helix and bottom circle, mm/min. A drill doesn't use it.

material.description: The library material its feeds come from. Null: its own values.

method.description: How the holes are cut: `drill` with a drill, or `bore` (a helix) with an endmill.

name.description: A name for the operation, shown in the list and on the setup sheet. Empty: none.

part.description: The id of the part it belongs to (`parts`).

plunge_feed.description: A drill's feed down, or a bore's feed straight down to the start depth, mm/min.

select.description:
What the operation cuts: the circles among the shapes on a layer, or shapes by id.
Other shapes are skipped with a note.

start_depth.description:
Where the cut starts, mm down from the stock top: 0 for the top, more when an
earlier operation already cut down to there.

through.description:
Cut through the stock: how far below the stock bottom it ends, mm. The end depth is
then the stock thickness plus this, and follows the thickness. Null: the end depth as
set.

tool.description: The id of the project tool it cuts with (`tools`).

oneOf.description: Surface: the whole stock top taken down flat, in straight passes back and forth.

enabled.description: False: the operation stays in the project but isn't cut. Missing: true.

end_depth.description: How far down the stock top is taken, mm. At most the stock thickness.

margin.description: How far a part surface's area reaches past its shapes, mm: 0 or more. Since schema 40.

material.description: The library material its feeds come from. Null: its own values.

name.description: A name for the operation, shown in the list and on the setup sheet. Empty: none.

part.description:
The id of the part it belongs to (`parts`). A board surface is faced once, whatever
instances the part has; its part only says where it stands in the list.

plunge_feed.description: The feed going down beside the stock to each depth, mm/min.

select.description:
The closed shapes a part surface faces. Empty: a board surface, the whole stock.
Since schema 40.

start_depth.description: Where the cut starts, mm down from the stock top: 0 for the top.

step_down.description:
The deepest each pass goes, mm. The passes are equal, and the last one ends exactly
at the end depth.

stepover.description:
The distance between passes, as a fraction of the tool diameter: at least 0.1, at
most 0.9.

tool.description: The id of the project tool it cuts with (`tools`): an endmill.

oneOf.description: Relief: a 3D model carved from the top with the drop cutter, in parallel lines.

angle.description: The lines' direction, radians counter-clockwise from X.

enabled.description: False: the operation stays in the project but isn't cut. Missing: true.

end_depth.description:
The model's lowest point, mm down from the stock top: the start depth plus the
model's depth, made again from the model whenever the project is read or changed.

material.description: The library material its feeds come from. Null: its own values.

model.description: The id of the model it carves (`drawing.models`).

name.description: A name for the operation, shown in the list and on the setup sheet. Empty: none.

part.description: The id of the part it belongs to (`parts`).

plunge_feed.description: The feed going down to each line's first point, mm/min.

rim.description:
A flat round the model at the floor and a ramp up from it to the stock top. Missing:
none, the tool's centre stays within the area. Left out when missing.

roughing.description:
A roughing pass, cut just before: levels one step down apart, the tool kept the
allowance off the model. Missing: none. Left out when missing.

select.description:
The area: closed shapes, by default the model's outline. The tool's centre stays in
it, or with a rim, within the rim's reach round it.

smoothing.description:
A smoothing pass, cut after the roughing pass and before the finish: the surface
followed once, the allowance kept, taking the steps the roughing leaves. Only with a
roughing pass. Missing: none. Left out when missing.

start_depth.description: Where the model's top lies, mm down from the stock top: 0 for the top.

stepover.description:
The distance between lines, as a fraction of the tool diameter: more than 0, at most
0.9.

tool.description:
The id of the project tool it cuts with (`tools`): a ball nose, an endmill or a
V-bit.

zigzag.description: Back and forth (true), or every line the same way, lifting between them.

Part.description:
A part: a named group of operations, cut together, with its own copies
(docs/specs/parts.md §2). It owns no geometry: its operations select the shapes.

angle.description:
Instance 1, the part itself, turned about the part's centre, radians,
counter-clockwise, as an instance is; 0: as drawn. Since schema 39.

at.description: Instance 1 then moved, mm; (0, 0): where drawn. Since schema 39.

enabled.description: False: the part and all its operations stay in the project but aren't cut.

id.description: Its number, unique in the project: what operations name it by.

instances.description:
The part placed again: each instance the same shapes and operations moved, turned
and perhaps mirrored (instance 1 is the part itself, placed by `angle` and `at`, and
isn't listed). Empty: cut once. Since schema 38, in place of a grid of copies.

mirror.description:
Cut mirrored about the centre line of its box, the drawing as drawn. Missing: as
drawn. Left out when missing.

name.description: Its name, unique in the project, shown in the Browser, the report and the sheet.

order.description:
`by_operation`: each operation on every instance, then the next; `by_instance`:
every operation on one instance, then the next instance. Since schema 38.

setup.description: The id of the setup it is cut in (`setups`). Since schema 34.

turns.description:
How it may be turned when nested. Missing: a quarter turn at a time. Left out when
missing.

PictureDepth.description: How a picture model's picture is read as heights (docs/specs/picture-relief.md §3).

background.description: Grey shares up to this, 0 to 0.95, are background, not the model; 0: none.

gamma.description:
The heights raised to this power, 0.2 to 5: above 1 flatter low ground and steeper
tops.

invert.description: `inflate`: white is the shape; false: black is.

mode.description:
How the picture becomes heights: a depth map, or its shapes inflated. Missing: a
depth map.

profile.description: `inflate`: how a shape rises from its edge.

reach.description:
`inflate`: how far in from the edge the height grows, mm, more than 0; null: the
widest shape's half-width.

smoothing.description: A blur over the heights, its radius on the board, mm: 0 to 5.

threshold.description:
`inflate`: grey levels below this (1 to 254) are black; null: picked from the
picture.

white_high.description: White is the top, black the bottom; false: the other way round.

PictureMode.description: How a picture model's picture becomes heights (docs/specs/inflated-shapes.md §3).

oneOf.description: Brightness as height.
Its black-and-white shapes, each rising from its edge.

PieceBoard.description: The size of the boards pieces are cut from, mm.

PieceGrid.description: A grid of pieces given by hand.

Pieces.description: How a setup is cut in pieces (docs/specs/pieces.md §10).

board.description:
The boards the pieces are cut from: each piece, its joints and the setup's margin
fit on one.

clearance.description: The room between two pieces at a seam, mm, for glue: each side gives half.

grid.description: Columns and rows of pieces. Null: the fewest whose pieces fit the board.

shift_x.description:
Each inner seam between columns moved along X from its even position, mm, from the
left. Missing ones: 0.

shift_y.description:
Each inner seam between rows moved along Y from its even position, mm, from the
bottom. Missing ones: 0.

size.description: The joint's size, mm: a knob's head diameter, a finger's length.

spacing.description: How far apart joints are along a seam, mm: knob to knob, or a finger and a gap.

Placement.description:
Where the imported drawing is put: a DXF point p goes to scale · rotate(p) + (dx, dy),
turned and scaled about the DXF's origin.

rotation.description:
Turned counter-clockwise about the DXF's origin, degrees, at least 0 and less than
360, after the scale. Multiples of 90 are exact.

scale.description: Scaled about the DXF's origin by this factor, 0.001 to 1000; 1: as drawn.

start_depth.description:
Where the outline is taken, mm down from the stock top: more than the operation's
start depth, less than its end depth. The end depth less this is the glue gap.

PocketFinish.description: A finishing pass on a pocket.

floor.description:
Left above the end depth by the roughing, mm: 0 or more, at most the step down, less
than the cut; 0 on a pocket cut through.

wall.description: Left on every wall by the roughing, mm: 0 or more, less than the tool radius.

RampShape.description: How a flute's ramp goes down from its end to the full depth.

oneOf.description: Evenly: depth × u, u from 0 at the end to 1 at full depth.
Steepest at the surface, easing into the floor: depth × sin(π/2 × u).

Register.description: How a turned board is located again.

oneOf.description: Dowel pins through holes on the turn axis, drilled with the front.
Pushed into the same corner of a fence: the board's size must be exact.

ReliefRim.description:
A relief's rim (docs/specs/stl-relief.md §16): a flat at the floor round the area, then a
ramp up to the stock top.

corner_radius.description: `box` only: the radius of the flat's outer corners, mm, from 0 to the width.

hull.description:
`outline` only: how far the outline is filled out towards its convex hull before the
flat goes round it, 0 (as it is) to 1 (the hull). Missing: 0.

ramp.description:
The ramp's slope from the flat up to the stock top, radians from horizontal: from 10°
to 90° (a straight wall).

shape.description: `outline`: the area's outer loops grown; `box`: the rectangle round them.

width.description: The flat's width, mm from the outline or the rectangle: 0 or more.

ReliefRoughing.description:
A relief's roughing pass (docs/specs/stl-relief.md §5): the material taken down in levels
with the raster, an allowance left on the model for the finish.

allowance.description: What is left on the model for the finish, mm, in every direction: 0 or more.

enabled.description: False: kept, but not cut. Missing: true.

plunge_feed.description: The feed going down to each stretch's first point, mm/min.

stepover.description:
The distance between lines, as a fraction of the tool diameter: more than 0, at most
0.9.

tool.description: The id of the project tool it cuts with (`tools`): an end mill or a plain ball nose.

ReliefSmoothing.description:
A relief's smoothing pass (docs/specs/stl-relief.md §17): after the roughing, the surface
followed once with the raster, an allowance left on the model for the finish.

allowance.description: What is left on the model for the finish, mm, in every direction: 0 or more.

angle.description:
The lines' direction, radians counter-clockwise from X: across the roughing's by
default.

enabled.description: False: kept, but not cut. Missing: true.

plunge_feed.description: The feed going down to each line's first point, mm/min.

stepover.description:
The distance between lines, as a fraction of the tool diameter: more than 0, at most
0.9.

tool.description: The id of the project tool it cuts with (`tools`): an end mill or a plain ball nose.

Rest.description:
Rest machining: the pocket clears only the material the larger tool `after_tool` can't
reach in its shapes.

after_tool.description: The id of the larger project tool whose leftovers this pocket clears.

oneOf.description: The area's outer loops, grown with round corners.
The rectangle round the area's outer loops, grown, its corners rounded.

dxf.description: Only shapes from this DXF (an id in `drawing.dxfs`).

exclude.description:
Shapes of that DXF, image, text or group left out (ids); with `dxf`, `image`,
`text` or `group` only. A contour with any of them isn't cut. A traced image's, or a text's, are found
again when it is made again.

group.description:
The shapes and texts' letters of this group (an id in `drawing.groups`), as they
are at each run.

image.description: Only shapes traced from this image (an id in `drawing.images`).

layer.description: Every shape on this layer (upper or lower case don't matter).

model.description: The footprint outline of this 3D model (an id in `drawing.models`).

text.description: Only the letters of this text (an id in `drawing.texts`).

Setup.description:
A setup: one board clamped once on the machine, with its stock and work zero, and the
parts cut from it (docs/specs/setups.md §2).

back_of.description:
Set: this setup is the back of another, the same board turned over. Its stock and
work zero then follow that setup's ([`Job::follow_fronts`]), and its cuts are
mirrored about the board's centre line. Null: a board of its own. Since schema 36.

enabled.description: False: the setup and its parts stay in the project but aren't cut.

id.description: Its number, unique in the project: what parts name it by.

name.description: Its name, shown in the Browser, the report and the setup sheet.

nest.description:
How the setup was last nested: its gap and margin, kept so *Nest again* needs no
questions. Missing: never nested. Left out when missing.

pieces.description:
Set: the setup is cut as a puzzle, in pieces that each fit a board, joined by
seams with joints; each piece is a program of its own. Null: one board. Since
schema 37.

work_zero.description:
The point of the drawing that becomes X0 Y0 in its G-code. Missing: the drawing's
origin.

Shape.description:
One shape of the drawing: imported from a DXF (`path`: lines and arcs, one shape per DXF
entity), or drawn in Chipload (`circle`, `rectangle`, `polyline`). One flat object:
`id`, `layer`, `kind`, then the fields of that kind.

angle.description:
rectangle: its rotation about the centre; polygon: the angle of its first corner from
+X; radians, counter-clockwise.

bulges.description:
polyline: one per segment, as in DXF: tan(sweep / 4); 0 straight, 1 a
counter-clockwise half circle, -1 clockwise.

center.description: circle, rectangle, polygon: the centre, mm.

closed.description: path, polyline: whether it ends where it starts.

construction.description:
circle, rectangle, polygon, polyline: construction geometry, shown and snapped to but
never cut; left out when false.

corner_radius.description: rectangle: the radius of its corners, mm; 0 for sharp ones.

dxf.description: path: the DXF it was imported from (its id in `drawing.dxfs`).

dxf_handle.description:
path: the handle of the DXF entity it came from, which keeps its id when the DXF is
updated.

dxf_type.description: path: the DXF entity's type, e.g. LWPOLYLINE.

id.description: The shape's id, which operations select it by.

image.description: path: the image it was traced from; absent for shapes from a DXF.

kind.description:
`path` (imported from a DXF), or a shape drawn in Chipload: `circle`, `rectangle`,
`polyline`.

length.description: rectangle: its size along its own X axis, mm.

model.description: path: the 3D model it is the footprint outline of (its id in `drawing.models`).

name.description: circle, rectangle, polyline: its name in the Browser; left out when it has none.

radius.description: circle: the radius, mm; polygon: the radius to its corners, mm.

segments.description: path: its lines and arcs, mm.

sides.description: polygon: how many sides (and corners) it has, 3 to 1000.

text.description: path: the text it is a letter of (its id in `drawing.texts`).

width.description: rectangle: its size along its own Y axis, mm.

ShapeGroup.description:
Drawn shapes and texts kept together: one click selects them all, and they move, turn,
scale and are cut as one (docs/specs/shape-groups.md). A shape or text is in at most one
group; groups don't hold groups.

id.description: The group's id, which operations' selectors name.

name.description: Its name in the Browser.

rotation.description:
How far its box is turned, degrees counter-clockwise, in [0, 360): the turns it was
given, so that its box turns with it (docs/specs/dxf-whole-on-canvas.md §6). 0 for a
new group.

texts.description: Its texts, by id, with their letters.

Skin.description: An onion skin on a profile.

thickness.description: Left above the end depth until the last lap, mm: more than 0, at most the step down.

SourceIssue.description: An import-time issue that can't be recomputed from the shapes.

code.description:
What kind of issue, e.g. `duplicate` or `open_contour` (see the import page of the
guide).

oneOf.description: M3
M4

fit.description:
Centred on the drawing only: its size is the drawing's outline plus this margin each
side, mm, following the drawing; `x` and `y` are then used only while the drawing is
empty. Null: the size is `x` × `y`.

material.description:
The project's material: new operations take it, with its values. Each operation
names its own (`material` on the operation). Null: none.

max_overcut.description: How far a cut may go below the stock bottom, into the spoilboard, mm.

origin.description:
Where the stock lies: its `bottom_left` corner or its `center` at the drawing's
origin, or centred on the drawing itself (`drawing`), following it.

thickness.description: Thickness, mm. Depths count down from the top.

z_zero.description: Where Z0 is: the stock `top` or `bottom`.

oneOf.description:
Centred on the drawing's outline, sticking out equally all round, and following the
drawing when it moves or changes (the user, 2026-10-28). Construction geometry
doesn't count; an empty drawing centres it on the origin.

along.description:
Where a ring without tabs placed by hand gets its `count` tabs: on its edges along
`x` (bottom and top) or `y` (left and right), half on each. Left out: evenly round
it.

at.description:
Tab centres placed by hand, in drawing coordinates (mm): a contour with points gets
exactly those tabs, one without gets `count`, evenly spaced. Left out when empty.

flank_angle.description:
The slope of the tab's sides, radians: π/2 (90°) straight, less for sloped tabs a
ramped profile follows.

height.description: The bridge's thickness, up from the bottom of the cut, mm.

width.description: The bridge left on the part, along its edge, mm (the flat top of a sloped tab).

Text.description:
A text written into shapes: what it says, its font and size, and where it goes. Its
letters are `path` shapes on its layer that name it in `text`, made again when it
changes; the font is needed only for that, not to cut them.

align.description: How the lines line up against each other.

anchor.description:
What `x` and `y` are: the box's lower-left corner (before the turn), or its centre.
A centred text stays centred there when its words, font or size change. Missing:
the corner.

font.description:
The font: a built-in one (FreeSans, FreeSerif, …) or one on the computer, by its
full name (`chipload text fonts`). Only its name is stored; its letters are the
text's shapes, kept where the font isn't (docs/specs/system-fonts.md).

height.description: The height of a capital letter, mm.

id.description: The text's id, which its letters name.

layer.description: The layer its letters go on.

line_spacing.description: From one line's base to the next, in capital heights.

rotation.description:
Turned counter-clockwise about the box's centre, degrees, at least 0 and less than
360.

spacing.description: Extra space between letters, mm; 0: the font's own spacing, kerning included.

text.description: What it says; a line break ("\n") starts a new line.

x.description:
X of the text's anchor on the stock, mm: the lower-left corner of its box (before
the turn) or its centre.

y.description: Y of the text's anchor on the stock, mm.

TextAlign.description: How a text's lines line up.

oneOf.description: The lower-left corner of the text's box, before the turn.
The centre of the text's box (the turn keeps it in place).

angle.description:
V-bits: the included angle, radians. Null: unknown; a V-carve then refuses the tool.
Ball noses: the taper's included angle; null: a plain ball nose.

center_cutting.description:
Whether it can plunge straight down. False: profiles ramp in and pockets go down
round a helix. Null: unknown.

corner_radius.description:
End mills: the radius of its corners, mm, a bull nose (docs/specs/corner-radius.md
§2). Missing: square corners. Left out of the file when missing, so a Chipload that
doesn't know it refuses only a tool that has one.

diameter.description: Diameter, mm. For a V-bit, its widest cutting diameter.

flutes.description: Number of flutes, for the chip load. Null: unknown.

id.description: The tool's number: what operations name it by, and its T number in the G-code.

library_uid.description:
The `uid` of the library tool it came from, for reference; nothing that cuts reads
it. Null: not from the library.

name.description: The library tool it came from, for reference.

rpm.description: Spindle speed, rpm. Needed to generate.

tip_diameter.description:
V-bits: the flat tip's diameter, mm. Null: pointed. Tapered ball noses: the ball's
diameter at the tip.

ToolChange.description: How a job with several tools is written.

oneOf.description: One G-code file per tool group; the user changes the tool and sets Z zero between.
One file with `T<n> M6` at each change, for a sender that handles it.

A ball nose, plain or tapered (docs/specs/stl-relief.md §8): for reliefs and follow
paths only.

Turn.description: How a board is turned over: about its vertical or its horizontal centre line.

oneOf.description: About the vertical centre line: the left edge goes to the right, X is mirrored.
About the horizontal centre line: the bottom edge goes to the top, Y is mirrored.

Turns.description:
How a part may be turned when it is nested (docs/specs/nesting.md §3): wood grain is
the usual reason for none or half.

oneOf.description: As it lies.
As it lies or turned 180°.
A quarter turn at a time.
15° at a time.
Declared by the file: a DXF's $INSUNITS, an SVG's size in real units.
The file declared none; the user chose (a DXF's units, an SVG's pixels per inch).

Wall.description: One of a corner's two walls, by length.

WorkZero.description: Where the G-code's X0 Y0 is. The geometry never moves; only the output is translated.

oneOf.description:
The drawing's own origin (the only choice before work_zero existed). An empty struct
variant, not a unit one, so serde refuses stray fields here too.
A corner or the centre of the stock, as placed by `stock.origin`.
Any point, in drawing coordinates (mm).

x.description: X of the point, drawing coordinates, mm.

y.description: Y of the point, drawing coordinates, mm.

description: Schema version 40. Older files load through Chipload's migrations; this schema describes only the current version.

active_part.description:
The part new operations go into (its id). Null or no such part: the first part.
Only the app and the command line read it; it changes nothing that is cut.

active_setup.description:
The setup shown, simulated and previewed, where new parts go (its id). Null or no
such setup: the first. Only the app and the command line read it.

drawing.description: The drawing: the shapes Chipload cuts, imported from a DXF or drawn in Chipload.

machine.description: The machine: post-processor, safe height, limits.

operations.description: The operations, cut in this order: grouped by part, in the parts' order.

parts.description:
The parts: groups of operations, each cut with its copies before the next part.
At least one.

schema_version.description: The version of the file format. Chipload upgrades older files when it reads them, and refuses newer ones.

setups.description:
The setups: each a board clamped on the machine, with its stock, its work zero and
the parts cut from it, written as a program of its own. At least one. Since schema 34.

tools.description: The tools the operations cut with.

written_by.description: The Chipload version that wrote the file, for reference.
